title: FreshYoz
description: FreshYoz is a modpack that was created for an enjoyable game. This modpack was inspired by other modpacks. It was created for a pleasant game, it has animations.:The Player, Mobs, Items, and more. there is a new atmosphere thanks to the ATMOSPHERICS mod.
body: FreshYoz is a modpack that was created for an enjoyable game. This modpack was inspired by other modpacks. It was created for a pleasant game, it has animations.:The Player, Mobs, Items, and more. there is a new atmosphere thanks to the ATMOSPHERICS mod, hand animation with the Punchy! mod, Dungeons and Taverns gives new and updated dungeons. This is my first and only project at the moment.Even though my computer isn't the best, my FPS is consistently around 200.
